response.description:
Azure Firewall Premium now delivers up to 22 Gbps
throughput with TLS inspection and IDPS in Deny mode, a 120% increase from 10
Gbps, and up to 600 Mbps per TCP connection with IDPS enabled in either Alert
or Deny mode (doubled from 300 Mbps). Learn
more.
response.title: Generally Available: 2.2X IDPS performance optimization in Azure Firewall
